terra.problem: The verses instruct that the Levites take a young bull; they do not say they actually took one.
The verses instruct Moses to bring the Levites and Aaron to present them; they do not say these actions had yet occurred.
The line switches from referring to the LORD as 'He' to saying 'I struck,' incorrectly changing the speaker. The LORD is the one who struck down Egypt's firstborn.
The verses say Levite men may enter the work at age twenty-five or older, not that every Levite starts at exactly twenty-five.
